I am currently FTP'ing both an OLDIO and a NEWIO over to [NEW,LSP].
(version 1567)
As for changes and fixes, well, I guess there really isn't anything
major (most new developments has been on ITS features for FASLOAD and the
like to make MACSYMA happier!).  GETDDTSYM has been hacked to use LISP's
mini-symbol-table (this is perhaps useful).  Other then that, I guess there
is no reason to bring it up (there are probably some didly bug fixes)...
But you might want to give it a go anyway and let me know if I introduced
any major new screws.....
